title: Pianists Helen Jackson and Nellie Reese
summary: Ida describes local women pianists Helen Jackson and Nellie Reese, and notes R.D. played drums.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah. Who is Helen Jackson? Helen Jackson was a piano player. She lives on East Street. My father was supposed to marry her mother, but he didn't marry his other lady, so she was a wonderful piano player, but she doesn't play anymore now. She's in bad health.
Oh, yeah? Yeah. Well, that's too bad. Yeah. Certainly, yeah. Did she play by ear or read?
She read and played ear too.
All right, she read it. She plays jazz and jazz.
